shortIntro: Software Engineering student passionate about software development, creating intuitive user experiences, and combining technology, design, and AI to solve real-world problems.
aboutParagraphs: I'm a Software Engineering student passionate about software development, UI/UX design, and creating intuitive, user-friendly experiences. I enjoy turning complex problems into solutions that are clear, accessible, and easy to use.

My experience spans UX research, user interviews, wireframing, prototyping, interface design in Figma, and hands-on software development. This combination helps me approach design with an understanding of technical feasibility and approach development with a focus on usability.

I'm also exploring AI-powered tools and workflows to improve research, design, and development. From organizing research insights to experimenting with AI-assisted solutions, I enjoy finding new ways to combine creativity and technology to solve real-world problems.

projects.name: CampusPulse — University Events & Societies Platform
projects.description: A university-focused platform designed to bring student societies, campus events, and announcements together in one accessible place.
projects.problem: University event information and society announcements can be scattered across different channels, making it difficult for students to stay informed about campus activities.
projects.solution: Designed and developed a centralized campus platform concept for discovering university events, exploring society activities, and accessing important announcements in one place.
projects.outcome: A university-focused web project that aims to make campus events and society information easier to discover and access.

projects.name: University Portal — Academic Dashboard
projects.description: A case study redesigning a university student portal's academic profile and dashboard screen, grounded in real user research rather than assumption.
projects.problem: Existing student portals (benchmarked against Canvas, Moodle, and Blackboard, including a review of Canvas app store feedback) buried the information students actually needed under dense, cluttered navigation.
projects.solution: Conducted 4 user interviews and a research synthesis, then used the findings to cut roughly 40% of the original UI elements — defending each specific cut against the research rather than trimming arbitrarily.
projects.outcome: A leaner academic dashboard concept where every remaining element is tied back to a stated user need. [Add final metrics or feedback if available.]

projects.name: Storyverse
projects.description: A UI/UX design project focused on creating an engaging and user-friendly digital experience for discovering and exploring stories.
projects.problem: Users needed a simple and engaging way to discover, explore, and interact with stories.
projects.solution: Designed an intuitive interface with clear navigation, structured content, and an engaging user experience.
projects.outcome: Created a polished high-fidelity prototype that demonstrates a clear and user-friendly story discovery experience.
